Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin suggerō.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /su.ʒeˈɾi(ʁ)/ [su.ʒeˈɾi(h)]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /su.ʒeˈɾi(ʁ)/ [su.ʒeˈɾi(h)]
    • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /su.ʒeˈɾi(ɾ)/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /su.ʒeˈɾi(ʁ)/ [su.ʒeˈɾi(χ)]
    • (Caipira) IPA(key): /su.ʒeˈɾi(ɻ)/
 
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /su.ʒɨˈɾiɾ/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /su.ʒɨˈɾiɾ/
    • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /su.ʒɨˈɾi.ɾi/

  • Audio (Brazil (Caipira)):(file)
  • Homophone: sugeri (Brazil)
  • Hyphenation: su‧ge‧rir

Verb

[edit]

sugerir (first-person singular present sugiro, third-person singular present sugere, first-person singular preterite sugeri, past participle sugerido)

  1. to suggest

Venetan

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • sujerir

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin suggerō (compare Italian suggerir).

Verb

[edit]

sugerir

  1. (transitive) to suggest
  2. (transitive) to prompt
